record.t: Was sworn in as Arkansas's 21st Lieutenant Governor on January 10, 2023.
record.q: Leslie Carol Rutledge was sworn in on January 10, 2023 as Arkansas’s 21st Lieutenant Governor and the first woman to ever hold the State’s second-highest office.

record.t: Served two terms as the 56th Attorney General of Arkansas from 2015 to 2023.
record.q: Rutledge previously served two-terms as the 56th Attorney General of Arkansas from 2015-2023.

record.t: Was elected Arkansas Attorney General, the first woman elected to the office.
record.q: She was also the first woman and first Republican elected to the office of Attorney General.
